Student work and submitted content are not used to train the AI models.
Khan Academy does not let large language models train on student data.
Usage and progress reports can be exported as CSV files.
The school can request deletion of a student's account when it is no longer needed.

reviews.summary: Some reviewers say the free mentor advice is useful and that SCORE has many mentors with different skills. Reviewers say mentors were not helpful or knowledgeable, the program did not meet their needs, and their contact details were shared with third parties who sent spam.

pricing.note: SCORE mentoring is always free, with no cap on sessions, while some workshops, advanced programs and SCORE Academy courses charge a fee shown on each event page before registering.

score-mentoring.caution: Only aspiring or established owners of U.S.-based businesses are eligible, and paid workshops or SCORE Academy courses are separate from the free mentoring. Mentor replies typically take a few business days and may land in your spam folder. The results do not name any apps that integrate directly with SCORE for end users; Salesforce Engage is only mentioned as the tool SCORE chapters use internally to connect mentors.

description.summary: SCORE is a free, confidential service where experienced volunteer business mentors give one-on-one advice to small business owners, along with free and paid workshops and resources. It is a nonprofit and a resource partner of the U.S. Small Business Administration.
helpsWith: Get one-on-one guidance from experienced volunteer mentors on business planning, funding, sales, marketing, accounting, operations, and hiring
Find mentors by expertise, industry, and location, or get matched through a ZIP code request
Attend free recorded webinars and some free live workshops, with some paid programs
Use free templates, guides, and articles on starting, growing, and transitioning a business

reviews.summary: Users like the engaging, gamified lessons, short practice sessions that fit busy schedules, and the easy-to-use interface. Users dislike repetitive lessons, frequent ads and hearts limits in the free version, weak customer support and billing issues, and limited grammar and conversation practice.

pricing.note: Duolingo has a free plan, a Super plan at $16.99 per month or $119.99 per year, and a Super Family plan at $143.99 per year, and Duolingo for Business sells discounted bulk Super subscriptions to employers, but no business-specific per-month price appears in the results.

duolingo.caution: Duolingo does not publish one fixed price list, so prices shown on checkout may differ by account, platform and country, and a Lite plan appears to be in testing only. The results do not give a monthly price for Duolingo for Business or any fees for small businesses, and the results name no integrations with other apps. Check duolingo.com and languageappguide.com for current prices.

description.summary: Duolingo is a free language-learning app and website with short, game-like lessons. For small businesses, Duolingo for Business gives staff access to its courses for one discounted yearly price per learner.
helpsWith: Practice English with short 5-minute lessons that cover reading, writing, listening and speaking, as shown on the English course page
Keep staff motivated with streaks, XP points and leaderboards that compete with learners around the world
Let employees learn on their own schedule with bite-sized lessons on their phone
Buy up to 1,000 discounted Super Duolingo accounts through the self-service tool and hand out access codes to employees

ai.feature: Gives learners AI video call practice, explanations of their mistakes, and roleplay chats, with lessons and exercises built using AI tools behind the scenes.

guide.paywall: No ads, unlimited hearts, personalized practice, unlimited Legendary attempts, and AI Video Call and Roleplay with Max need a paid plan.

policies.say: You can cancel your Super Duolingo subscription in your account settings, in the App Store or in Google Play. It stays active until the end of the billing period.
Payments are not refunded for partly used periods. App Store and Google Play purchases are refunded by Apple or Google.
A paid subscription renews automatically each period until you cancel it before the renewal date.
The documents do not say whether your data is used to train AI.
You can request a copy of all your personal data through the Duolingo Data Vault, which can take up to 30 days.

reviews.summary: Users like the ease of use, the high-quality courses from expert instructors, the easy LinkedIn certificate integration, and the ability to learn at their own pace. Users dislike the poor search and filtering tools, limited interactivity and hands-on practice, the high price, some outdated or basic courses, and app bugs such as battery drain and login problems.

pricing.note: LinkedIn Learning has no free plan beyond a 1-month free trial; the Monthly plan is $39.99 per month and the Annual plan is $239.88 per year (about $19.99 per month, with some sources quoting $323.88 per year or $26.99 per month), while individual courses cost $20 to $50 each and Team plans for organizations are quote-based.

linkedin-learning.caution: Quoted prices differ between sources, and current US pricing for new subscribers should be checked on LinkedIn's own pricing page; the free trial requires entering card details and will convert to a paid subscription unless cancelled.

description.summary: LinkedIn Learning is an online platform with thousands of expert-led video courses in business, technology and creative skills, and you can earn certificates of completion to show on your profile. Many public libraries offer free access to it with a library card.

ai.feature: Gives your team an AI coach that answers learning questions with advice pulled from LinkedIn Learning courses, and lets them practice hard conversations with AI role play that gives feedback.

policies.say: You can cancel your LinkedIn Learning subscription at any time, but access to paid courses ends after your current billing cycle.
Premium subscriptions including LinkedIn Learning may be refundable within 7 days of being charged if you have not used Premium features, and some countries give longer refund rights.
Purchases are non-cancelable and payment is non-refundable, except as the agreement states or local law allows.

reviews.summary: Users like the ease of use, the variety of study options, and the ability to create and share flashcards. Users dislike that many features are now behind a paywall, the unreliable Quiz option, intrusive ads, app glitches, and weak support for problem solving skills.

pricing.note: Quizlet has a free plan with flashcards, games and limited Learn and Test. Quizlet Plus costs $9.99 a month or $44.99 a year on the US App Store, Quizlet Plus Unlimited is the higher tier, and Quizlet Plus for teachers costs $35.99 a year; group plans for schools are discounted, but the results do not give small business pricing.

quizlet.caution: Subscriptions renew automatically and app-store prices can differ from the website. Quizlet is built for students and teachers, and the results do not show any business plan for a small US company, so it may not fit that use. Pricing details come from theexpertranking.com and quizlet.com, and integrations come from getapp.com.

description.summary: Quizlet is a study platform with flashcards, practice tests, and AI tools that turn notes, slides, and PDFs into study material. It is built mainly for students and teachers, so a small business would use it mostly for staff training and learning.

ai.feature: Generates practice tests, study guides, flashcards, and summaries from uploaded notes and documents for students and teachers, with edits allowed afterward.

plans.name: Quizlet Plus
plans.includes: 3 practice tests, 20 Learn rounds and 3 textbook solutions a month; ad-free; billed yearly at $35.99 (monthly billing is $7.99)

guide.trial: Annual plans include a 7-day free trial with no monthly trial option; a card is required, and you must cancel before renewal to avoid charges.
guide.paywall: Learn and Test modes, Study Guides and Expert Solutions beyond the small monthly limits, and removing ads need a paid plan.
accountSteps: Log in to your account.
Create flashcard sets, folders, or classes to start studying.
Optionally choose a paid plan such as Quizlet Plus from the subscription page.

policies.say: You can cancel your subscription at any time, but you must cancel at least 1 day before it renews to avoid being charged again.
Subscriptions bought directly from Quizlet are not refundable, except where the law requires a refund.
Subscriptions renew automatically, monthly or yearly, and you can end them at any time; there is no stated minimum commitment.

pricing.note: The MigraWatch hotline is a free phone line run by United We Dream, with no paid plans, so there is no monthly price for a small US business.

migrawatch.caution: This is a community hotline for reporting ICE and CBP activity, not a business software product, so it does not offer business plans or app integrations.

description.summary: MigraWatch is a nationwide hotline run by United We Dream where people can report ICE or CBP activity in their community and get guidance and support. It is staffed by bilingual volunteers who are not attorneys and do not give legal advice.
helpsWith: Report ICE or CBP activity seen in your community by phone
Get know-your-rights information and referrals to local legal service providers
Send text alerts by texting 877877

nakasec-know-your-rights.caution: The app is not legal advice, and it is developed by HANA Center for NAKASEC, not a government entity.

description.summary: Know Your Rights 4 Immigrants is a free phone app from NAKASEC that gives immigrants general information about their rights and helps them prepare for emergencies. It is not legal advice and NAKASEC is not a government agency.
helpsWith: Plays your rights aloud to an ICE or law enforcement agent
Sends an emergency message to your pre-selected contacts
Offers a sample family preparedness plan
Provides contact information for consulates
description.howToStart: Download the free app from the Apple App Store or Google Play, or use the download links on the NAKASEC website, then open it and choose your language.

pricing.note: The National Immigration Law Center is a nonprofit organization and does not sell software plans; its services are free for most organizations, with a possible fee only for some in-person trainings, and donors can give one-time gifts or monthly amounts starting at $5 per month.
pricing.extraFees: There may be a fee for in-person trainings; a transaction fee can be covered by the donor if they choose to.

nilc-know-your-rights.caution: The organization is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that serves low-income immigrants and community organizations, not small businesses, and it generally does not take individual legal cases.

description.summary: The National Immigration Law Center is a nonprofit advocacy group that fights for the rights of low-income immigrants and their loved ones, including workers. It publishes free know-your-rights guides, including a guide for employers on what to do if immigration agents come to a workplace.
helpsWith: Read guidance on what employers can do if immigration agents come to a workplace
Share know-your-rights guides and resources with your staff
Find information on workers' rights, including fair pay and safe working conditions

reviews.summary: Users like the realistic, natural-sounding voices, the wide variety of voices, and the ease of use. Users dislike pronunciation errors with names, acronyms and technical terms, the high price and subscription model, limited languages, and weak customer service and refunds.

pricing.note: A free plan gives 3 download minutes a month without commercial rights; Starter is $10/month billed annually ($19 monthly), Pro is $33/month billed annually ($49 monthly), and Business is $160 per user per month billed annually.
pricing.extraFees: Extra minutes can be bought as add-ons, but the price is not published; the Business plan is priced per user, with a minimum of one seat.

wellsaid.caution: The free plan has no commercial rights, so a small business needs at least the Starter plan to use the audio commercially. Paid plans cap downloaded minutes (20 a month on Starter monthly, 240 a year on Starter annual) with no rollover, and payments are non-refundable.

ai.feature: Generates realistic AI voiceovers from a pasted script, with voices modeled on licensed recordings from real voice actors.

description.summary: WellSaid is an AI voice generator that turns written text into natural-sounding speech for voiceovers. Its voices are built from recordings made by licensed professional voice actors.
helpsWith: Turns a script into a natural-sounding voiceover in seconds
Lets you explore voices by tone, accent, language and style to find the right fit
Lets you adjust pronunciation, pacing and emphasis until the voiceover sounds right

Subscriptions renew automatically, monthly or annually, on your sign-up date unless you cancel.
You can download files you have made before your access ends, and you lose workspace access after the billing period.

pricing.note: The free plan costs nothing and keeps the site online on a cadu.page address with no time limit; the Personal plan is $9 a month billed yearly ($11 monthly) for a custom domain without Cadu branding, and the Business plan is $19 a month per site billed yearly ($23 monthly) for lead capture, visitor analytics and team seats.
pricing.extraFees: No per-message or per-transaction fees are listed; Business seats are free, and each extra site is charged at the same per-site rate.

cadu.caution: Cadu is not an e-commerce platform and cannot build online shops with carts or payments. Cancelling keeps paid features until the period ends, then the site reverts to the free tier with a 7-day grace period to resubscribe.

ai.feature: Reads a business owner's plain WhatsApp messages and builds or edits their website accordingly, so they never need a login or technical skills, as described on cadu.app.

helpsWith: Builds a full website from a short description of your business sent on WhatsApp
Updates text, images, prices, menus and opening hours by sending a WhatsApp message
Adds a contact form whose leads are sent to your WhatsApp, and lets you undo changes by saying "undo"
description.howToStart: Send a WhatsApp message to Cadu describing your business, and it will build your site and send you a link to the live page.

plans.name: Free forever

plans.name: Business

guide.paywall: Your own custom domain needs the Personal plan.

helpsWith: Writes captions, hashtags and images with built-in AI
Schedules posts to Facebook, Instagram, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok and other platforms

Write or schedule your first post.

Import posts in bulk using a CSV file.
